summary_en: Lantern-lit stalls selling dango, local sake and small crafts in the old castle town.
description_en: Our fictional market sits on the main street below the castle, where the lanterns come on as the light fades.
Graze on grilled dango, pick up a bottle from a local brewery, and leave room for something sweet.
access_en: Around 15 minutes on foot from the station.
image_alt: Illustration of a row of glowing paper lanterns above a market stall
